title: Syncraze
description: A comprehensive enterprise management platform designed to digitize and streamline business workflows, inspections, compliance processes, custom data collection, and reporting. The platform provides configurable modules that allow organizations to create dynamic forms, define multi-level approval workflows, collect structured operational data, and generate customized reports from the collected information.

features.title: Dynamic Workflow Management
features.description: Designed and developed configurable workflows to automate business processes from initiation to completion. Supported multi-step approval flows, role-based actions, status transitions, workflow assignments, and structured approval processes.

features.title: Custom Form Builder
features.description: Developed a dynamic form-building system that allows administrators to create customized forms without modifying the application code. Supported multiple field types, sections, validations, dropdowns, text fields, date fields, numeric fields, attachments, dynamic options, and configurable form structures.

features.title: Advanced Multi-Section Forms
features.description: Implemented multi-section and nested form structures for complex operational processes. Forms can be organized into logical sections with configurable fields, validation rules, conditional options, and structured data collection.

features.title: Custom Report Builder
features.description: Developed configurable reporting functionality to convert collected form and workflow data into structured reports. Supported dynamic columns, filters, sorting, search, pagination, status-based filtering, and business-specific report views.

features.title: Dynamic Inspection & Audit Templates
features.description: Built configurable inspection and audit templates that allow administrators to define inspection sections, questions, response types, scoring or status-based inputs, remarks, attachments, and other operational requirements.

features.title: Permit Management
features.description: Implemented permit management workflows with dynamic forms, configurable permit types, approval stages, status tracking, and structured data collection for operational activities.

features.title: Role-Based Access Control
features.description: Implemented role-based access and permission management to control module visibility and user actions based on assigned roles and responsibilities.

features.title: Dynamic Options & Configuration
features.description: Created reusable dynamic configuration components for managing dropdown values, categories, options, statuses, and other configurable master data used across forms and workflows.

features.title: Data Validation
features.description: Implemented structured client-side and server-side validation using Zod and custom validation rules to ensure accurate and consistent data submission.

features.title: Admin Dashboard & Data Management
features.description: Developed responsive administrative interfaces for managing users, workflows, forms, templates, reports, configurations, and operational records using reusable React and Material UI components.

title: CNI Business Forum
description: A comprehensive portal for educational institutions to manage student records, track attendance, and process grading. Replaced a legacy paper system with a secure digital database.

title: Ramesh Traders POS
description: A workflow automation tool designed for a B2B business. It allows sales reps to instantly generate complex PDF quotations based on variable client inputs, saving hours of manual data entry.

title: Clothing Ecommerce
description: A workflow automation tool designed for a B2B business. It allows sales reps to instantly generate complex PDF quotations based on variable client inputs, saving hours of manual data entry.

title: Tiny Theatre
description: A high-conversion e-commerce platform built from the ground up. It features dynamic inventory management, secure checkout, and a custom admin dashboard to track orders and revenue.

title: Anbusuzhulagu Charity Platform
description: A comprehensive unified charity platform featuring a public-facing website, a management admin panel, and REST APIs powering mobile applications for donation and campaign management.

title: Happy Folks International Preschool
description: A freelance school management and institutional website project developed for Happy Folks International Preschool. The project includes a responsive public-facing website along with an administrative system for managing school-related information, student records, billing, and operational content.

features.title: School Website
features.description: Developed a responsive and professional school website to showcase the institution, programs, facilities, activities, admissions information, and contact details.

features.title: Admin Panel
features.description: Built an administrative dashboard to manage school information and operational data through a centralized interface.

features.title: Student Management
features.description: Implemented student-related data management with structured records and administrative controls.

features.title: Invoice & Billing
features.description: Developed a professional invoice generation interface for managing school billing information, fee details, calculations, and printable invoice layouts.

features.title: Content Management
features.description: Created configurable management screens for maintaining website content and school-related information without directly modifying the frontend code.

features.title: Responsive UI
features.description: Designed responsive interfaces optimized for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices with a clean and professional school-focused visual experience.
